d: Weddings come in all shapes and sizes, with differing personal tastes, cultural elements, and, of course, budgetary constraints. And so do wedding planners.
THIS OLD SPOUSE is a heartwarming reality TV show that focuses on couples who have lost some of the spark in their relationship.
This fashion industry couple fell in love ten years ago, and finally Italian bride Valentina and her Indian groom Shail tie the knot in an architectural gem in Florida.
Friends and family enjoy snowy activities before entering a beautiful ski lodge for Kristin and Gary's winter wonderland wedding in Colorado.
Old Hollywood meets Art Deco when planner Kevin Covey helps Danielle and Todd transform Los Angeles' storied Millennium Ballroom into an elegant dream.
Carly and Jason's love story comes full circle as they celebrate their nuptials in the Austin Ritz Carlton where they met and got engaged.
An Asian/Cuban fusion theme and plenty of New Years Eve festivities keeps Sajid and Gabe's reception rocking all night.
Beautiful all-white flowers and décor create a romantic and traditional affair for this very sweet couple.
Andrea and Glenn celebrate their nuptials in style with a 1920's Great Gatsby themed wedding in a glittering vintage car museum.
Carolina Panthers football player Thomas Davis and his bride Kelly Stokes tie the knot in regal style.
A private waterfront estate in Florida is the backdrop for the marriage of a young, hot, and fabulous couple.
This unique wedding incorporates everything from California wine country, to a cherry blossom motif, to a traditional Chinese wedding dress.
